book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Timoti lee ŋgoo yi Bol bɛ Sila le

Bol jiɛnyɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu bu a kilaantɛŋ kì Dɛbi le, wu gɛ̀ ja wu gɛɛŋ kì Lista le. Muh wu ŋgoo wu Jiso wumu gɛ̀ bee Lista ayu jee che nyu lɛ Timoti, bwee nyu muh wu Bajuu, wù nyu tɛ muh wu mbɛmɛ, geenɛ chiji gɛ̀ bee muh wu Baglek.
Timoti wunɛ gɛ̀ bee muh, bamii ba mbɛmɛ bachii ba Lista mo ba Ikoniuŋ bɛɛŋse wu.
Bol tu wu goone ki wu jô wu lɛ bɛ wu jiɛnyi, wu mo wu chvuu wu yeh.
Wu gɛ̀ chvuse wu yeh noo, nje Bajuu bachii ba gɛ̀ chee bimbe biyu le gɛ kee lo lɛ chiji Timoti gɛ̀ bee muh Baglek.
Bo tu bo jiɛnyi bo gɛɛne a bilaantɛŋ le, bo doo bo gɛɛne noo bo sɛŋe bamii ba mbɛmɛ, banchi ba booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso mo bachiji kintaashɛ ki Yɛlusalɛm gɛ̀ shilɛ bo bɛɛŋ lɛ ba gɛɛde.
Noo, bintaashɛ bi bamii ba mbɛmɛ biyu tu bi tɛɛme bi gɛɛne fwe fwe yi mbɛmɛ le. Bamii tu bo taade fɛ bo le aju achii.
Fiɛɛ njɛ kifilɛ to fɛ Bol le Towa
Bol bɛ ŋgoo ye ja ki bo gɛɛŋ bo fejɛ jɛ yi Nyo woŋ wu Ɛsia le, Kiyo ki Yuude faŋ. Bo mo bo jiɛnyɛ bo fe nyu je kimbe ki Fligia bɛ ki Galɛshiaŋ le.
Bo gɛ̀ doo bo gɛɛŋ bo bu mbebe woŋ wù Misia le bo goone ki bo lee bo gɛɛŋ kimbe kì Bitinia le, Kiyo ki Jiso ka ki faŋ.
Noo, bo mo bo fe woŋ wù Misia, bo daŋsɛ bo gɛɛŋ a kilaantɛŋ kì Towa le.
Lɛ to nyu antaŋ, fiɛɛ njɛ kifilɛ ja fi to fɛ Bol le. Wu yɛŋ a fiɛɛ fiyu le muh mu wu Masɛdonia lɛme wu lɛge wu lɛ, “Kii wo, daŋ gɛh wo to Masɛdonia yanɛ wo fih bee.”
No fiɛɛ fiyu gɛ to fɛ Bol le noo, besa bo
mo be yɛŋ lɛ Nyo le wu dunyɛ lɛ bee gɛɛŋ be fejɛ saaka we wù joŋe woŋ wù Masɛdonia le. Kimimia, bee mo be seesɛ ki bee gɛɛŋ yo.
Lidia leesɛ fitele yi Jiso le woŋ wu Filibi le
Bee ja Towa, bee daŋ chaaŋ a ŋguh wu a joo le, bee bu Samotɛ. Bvu bu bvu yuu bee gɛɛŋ fwe bee bu Niaboli.
Bee gɛ̀ ja fo bee jiɛnyɛ be gɛɛŋ Filibi, nyu kilaantɛŋ ki kimbe ki fwe le Masɛdonia.
Kilaantɛŋ kiyu gɛ̀ bee ki bala wu Lum. Bee che yo yi aju le.

Lɛ doo nyu juu chi yuuŋ, bee bu a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le, bee gɛɛŋ jwe wu joo le, fɛ bee gɛ̀ kwaji lɛ le kijusɛ ki Bajuu ki buunɛ. No bee gɛnɛ, bikɛse bamu gɛ̀ taashɛ wa fo, bee mo be shii bee tu be jɛme bo le.

Kwɛse wumu gɛ̀ bee fo wu yuge tɛ, jee che nyu lɛ Lidia, wù gɛ̀ bee wu ŋgvuune Nyo. Wu bu a kilaantɛŋ kì Tayatila le, wu gese kfuu chi njú yimi, yi nyu njɛ yi yɛɛde lo, yi tɛɛme kwa. Tada gwenyɛ fitele fie, wu bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì Bol gɛ̀ jɛme le.

Bo gɛ̀ leesɛ wu bɛ bamii ba a wu yeh a joo, wu mo wu lɛgɛ bee wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Kii bɛŋ, bɛŋ nɛ le bɛŋ yɛŋ lɛ nle nleesɛ fitele fiaŋ fichii yi Tada le, bɛŋ to gɛ, bɛŋ gɛɛŋ bɛŋ che a mɛ yeh.” Wu mɛ gɛh wu tu wu dode, bee ja be bɛɛŋ, bee gɛɛŋ.
Ba faa Bol bɛ Sila yeh yi ncha le Filibi

Lɛ to nyume juu chimi no bee gɛ̀ gɛɛne fɛ kijusɛ ki buunɛ le, bee tasɛ bɛ mwa wù kwɛse wumu wù nyu nfwa. Wu gɛ̀ kɛme kiyo kimu yi ye ye le, kì ge muh tu muh jiaaŋ. Bamii ba gɛ̀ kɛme mwa wù kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ̀ kade bige ye ye le chuule nje wu gɛ̀ sɛŋe mwɛɛ mù gɛ̀ bee ki mu kôoshi.
Mwa wù kwɛse wuyu doo wu yɛŋ besa Bol le, wu mo wu bii bee le wu wanɛ, wu duu lɛ, “Bamii banɛ le bamii ba lɛme ba Nyo wu le kikwɛɛ ki mwɛɛ munchii, bo duunyi je yì taŋlo bɛŋ jiɛnyɛ yu fɛ bɛŋ bonɛ.”

Wu gɛ̀ ge noo bu aju a duude le, fi gɛ̀ ja fi toonyɛ Bol, wu kaasɛ ye wu waŋ kiyo kiyu wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Njɛme wo le, a jee chi Jiso Kletu le, lɛ wo bu ye yi mwa wunɛ le.” Ki mo ki bû yi ye ye le fo ki sege.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ kɛme nfwa wɛɛ yɛŋ lɛ je yiboo yi bige le yi ka wa, bo mo bo koo Bol bɛ Sila bo chii bo, bo gɛɛŋ bɛ bo fwe a bachiji woŋ le fɛ waaŋ.
No bo gɛnɛ bɛ bo, bo leesɛ bo fwe a bala wu Lum wù gɛ̀ sage bansa bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bamii banɛ le Bajuu, bo nyaa ŋgɛ a kilaantɛŋ kesa le.
Bo yɛyi bamii bɛ kinche kì nchi wese baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ. Bee le bamii ba Lum, gɛ taŋlo bee bîi kinche kiyu le gɛ.”
Kinchvu ki bamii kì gɛ̀ bee fo mo ki tooŋ bo, bo gwe yi Bol bɛ Sila le. Bamii ba gɛ̀ sage bansa baa mo bo saayɛ njú yi Bol bɛ Sila, bo jɛmɛ lɛ ba taaŋ bo.
Bo suŋ bo wesee, bo jo bo bo gɛɛŋ bo leesɛ yeh yi ncha le, bo jɛmɛ lɛ muh wù to wu chiɛɛne yeh yi ncha wu chîɛɛne bo chuule.
No wu yu noo, wu mo wu jo bo wu gɛɛŋ wu faa bo a kibuu ki yeh yi ncha ki antɛŋ le, wu kaaŋ bikaa biboo yi kinfaŋa le.
Lɛ to nyume njɛ antaŋ antɛnɛɛ, Bol bɛ Sila buune bo yɛɛnɛ bo yuuse Nyo, bamii bancha yege,
nshɛŋ ja yi shiŋshɛ bɛ bvuŋga, yeh yi ncha shiŋshɛ yi gɛɛŋ yi bu yi kichi le. Kimimia, de yi fese yichii gwenyɛ, bancha faanyɛ yi bamii bancha le bachii.
Muh wù gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi ncha yiyu kaŋsɛ, wu doo wu yɛŋ lɛ de yi fese le yi gwenyɛ wa, wu mo wu tu wu kwaji lɛ bamii bancha baa le bo legɛ wa. Wu mo wu baa nyo a ŋku le lɛ wu yuuyɛ kikwɛɛ ke yu.
Bol waŋ fɛwɛɛwe wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Keefɛ wo yûuyɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ gɛ. Bee le fɛnɛ bee bachii.”
Muh wù gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi ncha yɛɛ tɛɛŋ muh, wu to bɛ kin'yesɛ, wu legɛ wu lee yeh, wu gɛɛŋ wu tuŋ anyuu a Bol bɛ Sila fwe wu koge bɛ nfaaŋ.
Wu ja wu jo bo, bɛ bo bu akfuuŋ, wu biih bo le lɛ, “Ba chii, taŋlo ŋge nɛɛ fɛ mbonɛ.”
Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Leesɛ fitele yi Tada Jiso le, bena bamii ba le a wo yeh bɛŋ ge bɛŋ bonɛ.”
Bo mo bo fejɛ saaka wu kune Tada fɛ bamii ba a wu yeh le.
Wu jo bo gɛh kitaŋ kiyu le, wu chugɛ banfu baboo. Kimimia, bo mo bo leesɛ wu bɛ bamii be bachii ba a wu yeh a joo.
Wu mo wu jo bo, bɛ bo bɛɛŋ a wu yeh, wu nya mwɛɛ munjile bo ji. Bɛ bamii bachii ba a wu yeh mo bo tu bo laŋeye lɛ bo le bo lee wa muntele yi Nyo le.
Akfuuŋ bu ayuu, bala wu Lum wɛɛ wu gɛ̀ sage bansa tuŋ bamii ba nchi lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo du muh wù chiɛɛne yeh yi ncha yɛɛ le lɛ wu bvusɛ bamii baa bo gɛ̂ɛne.
Muh wù gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi ncha yiyu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Bol le, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bala le wu tuŋ ntuŋ lɛ ba bvusɛ bɛŋ, bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛne yi kimbonɛ le.”

Geenɛ, Bol jɛmɛ bamii ba nchi baa le lɛ, “Ba chi ba suŋ bee fɛ waaŋ, ba baaŋ sagɛ nsa wese gɛ, bee nyu tɛ bamii ba Lum, ba ka ba faa bee yeh, bo jɛme mɛɛse lɛ ba bvusɛ bee ajiŋ ajiŋ nɛ nɛɛ? Gɛ taŋlo fi kooshɛ noo gɛ. Le ge to gɛh bala wuyu fɛnɛ fɛ wu bvusɛ bee.”
Bamii ba nchi baa kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ, bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ bala wu Lum wɛɛ le no Bol jɛmɛ. Bo yu lɛ Bol bɛ Sila le tɛ bamii ba Lum, bo mo bo tu bo faane.
Bo mo bo to bo ku chiaaŋ bo le, bo bvusɛ bo yeh yi ncha le, bo chiiŋsɛ bo, bo lɛgɛ bo lɛ bo ja a kilaantɛŋ kɛɛ le.
Bol bɛ Sila bu yeh yi ncha le, bo gɛɛŋ a Lidia yeh, bamii ba mbɛmɛ nyu yu. Bo teefe bo, bo mo bo ja yo.

footnotes.text: Ba gɛ̀ chvuse Timoti yeh fi le lɛ taŋlo wu fêeji jɛ yi Nyo Bajuu le bo nyiɛŋse gɛ wu gɛ, no chiji gɛ̀ bee gɛ muh Bajuu gɛ.
Luka wù gɛ̀ saŋ ŋwa wunɛ gɛ̀ lee ŋgoo yi ba Bol le Towa, bɛ bo tu bo jiɛnyi.
Masɛdonia le ba gɛ̀ ga bimbe binɛh, kinɛ gɛ̀ bee kì fwe.
